apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Automation trigger «Увімкнення авто»** — fires once each time the car is switched on after the head unit slept
  (`sys.quickboot.enable` 1 → 0, then the bodywork power level reads ACC/ON), whether or not the app's process survived
  the sleep. «Запуск сервісу» did not fire on a normal morning start (2026-11-12: the car woke at 08:15 at 6 °C in the
  cabin, the warm-up rule never ran), because the service it watches was still alive from the night. Not yet seen
  firing on a real power-on — see `docs/features/automations.md`.
